exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise

source_english.description: A bodyweight standing calf raise lifts both heels from the floor while the toes remain planted and the hands lightly steady against a wall.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
form_cues: Keep the ankle vertical over the foot.
Rise evenly through the balls of both feet.
common_mistakes: Rolling the ankles outward or inward.
Bending the knees to create momentum.
source_english.safety_note: Use the machine, rack, or wall only for balance and keep the load light enough to control the ankle range.

exercises.name: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise

source_english.description: Hold support, raise one heel straight up from the floor, lower it fully, then change legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
form_cues: Keep the ankle over the second toe.
common_mistakes: Pushing off with the other leg.
source_english.safety_note: Use a handhold or machine support and keep the ankle moving vertically.

exercises.name: Spiderman

source_english.description: A Spiderman is a plank variation that draws one knee toward the same-side elbow while the trunk stays low and controlled.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and legs extended.
Brace the core and bring the right knee toward the outside of the right elbow.
Return the right leg to the plank without raising the hips.
Repeat on the left side, alternating smoothly.
form_cues: Move the knee outside the arm.
source_english.safety_note: Use a surface with enough traction for the hands and feet.

exercises.name: Plank Pushup

source_english.description: A plank push-up alternates between the forearms and hands while the body remains rigid in a plank.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with the body straight and feet set wide enough for balance.
Place one hand under the shoulder, then the other, pressing up to a high plank.
Lower back to the forearms one arm at a time while keeping the hips as still as possible.
Alternate the leading arm on each repetition.
form_cues: Move one arm at a time.
common_mistakes: Rocking the hips side to side.
Placing the hands too far forward.
source_english.safety_note: Use a surface that will not slip and stop if the shoulders or wrists cannot stay aligned.

exercises.name: Wall Sit

source_english.description: Wall Sit holds the back against a wall with knees bent and thighs near parallel to the floor.
instructions: Place the back against a clear wall and walk the feet forward.
Slide down until the knees are about 90 degrees and the thighs are near parallel.
Keep the back and head against the wall for the programmed duration.
Press through the feet to slide back up and stand.
common_mistakes: Feet too close to the wall.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a shallower knee angle if the knees cannot stay aligned and supported.

exercises.name: L-Sit Hold

instructions: Sit on the floor with hands beside the hips and legs extended.

Hold the legs straight and as parallel to the floor as your control allows.
Lower with control to end the hold.

source_english.safety_note: Use a comfortable range and stop if control or alignment deteriorates.

exercises.name: Decline Push Up

source_english.description: Decline Push Up lowers the chest from a braced plank and presses back up with the feet elevated.
instructions: Place your feet on a stable low step and hands on the floor.
Lower the chest toward the floor while keeping the trunk rigid.
Press through the palms; for clap push-ups, leave the floor briefly and land softly.
Reset the plank with elbows straight before the next repetition.
form_cues: Keep the body in one line.
source_english.safety_note: Use knees or an elevated surface until the plank and landing stay controlled.

exercises.name: Frog Pumps (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: Frog Pumps (Dumbbell) press the hips upward with the soles of the feet together while a dumbbell rests at the hips.
instructions: Lie on your back, bring the soles of the feet together, and place the dumbbell securely across the hip crease.
Brace the abdomen and press through the feet to lift the hips.
Pause when the glutes are contracted without arching the ribs.
Lower the hips slowly to the floor.
source_english.safety_note: Use a light dumbbell and pad the hips so the load stays stable.
